built_once: every outcome head consumes these blocks; no head owns an independent feature set
identity: cfb_identity_contract.json (provider ESPN athlete_id only; all-team SKILL history follows the id, role / deployment history is current-team)

team_and_context.T_N_SEASON: games T played this season before the target week
team_and_context.T_RUSH_B0: B0 blend of rush plays per game: (season-to-date sum + 3 x prior-season mean) / (n_season + 3); prior season missing -> league mean of the prior season
team_and_context.T_PLAYS_B0: same blend, plays (rush + pass attempt + sack plays)
team_and_context.T_RZ_B0: same blend, red-zone attributed plays (rush + pass)
team_and_context.T_RUSH_L3: mean rush plays over T's last 3 completed games (NaN if none)
team_and_context.T_PASS_L3: mean pass-attempt plays over T's last 3 completed games
team_and_context.O_RUSH_ALLOWED_B0: B0 blend of rush plays O's opponents ran against O
team_and_context.O_PLAYS_B0: B0 blend of O's own plays per game (pace)
team_and_context.T_RATING: internal Elo-type rating of T before the target week (prior completed games only; fixed K / HFA / season regression constants in the protocol)
team_and_context.O_IS_FCS: opponent division is FCS (separate low-information regime)
team_and_context.REST_DAYS: days since T's previous game (cap 21; missing -> 14)

player.P_APPS_L3: appearances (>=1 carry / reception / pass attempt) in T's last 3 completed games
player.P_GAMES_SINCE_APP: T games completed since the player's last appearance
player.P_RETURNING: player appeared for T in the previous season
player.P_TRANSFER_NEWCOMER: player's earliest appearance for T falls inside T's last 12 games AND the athlete_id has earlier appearances for another team (provider-ID stitched)
player.P_CARRY_SHARE_L5: player carries / team carries over T's last 5 completed games (team carries = sum of player carries)
player.P_ATT_SHARE_L5: player pass attempts / team pass attempts, last 5
player.P_CARRY_SHARE_ACTIVE_L5: carry share restricted to the games (of the last 5) in which the player appeared
player.P_CARRY_SHARE_DECAY: half-life-3-game decayed carry share over T's last 12 games
player.P_CARRIES_PER_APP_L10: carries per appearance over the player's last 10 appearances (all-team SKILL domain)
player.P_N_SKILL_APPS_10: appearances behind the all-team skill windows (<=10)
player.TEAM_N_ACTIVE_CARRIERS_L5: players with a >=10% carry share over T's last 5 games (depth competition)
player.TEAM_N_ACTIVE_RECEIVERS_L5: players with a >=10% reception share over T's last 5 games

available: returning-player flag (appeared for the team last season)
transfer-newcomer flag (same provider id, different earlier team)
organizational_intent_status.rule: observed usage overpowers these priors as appearances accumulate (they enter only through shrinkage weights and the two flags)

rating_constants.margin_multiplier: ln(|margin|+1) damped by the rating gap (fixed formula in cfb_phase1_team_environment.py)
rating_constants.note: fixed before any performance; internal results only; provider pregame Elo is NOT used

forbidden: sportsbook line / odds / spread / total / implied probability
injury / depth / snap / target features (no PIT source)
leakage_rules: R1 every feature uses games with (season, week) < target only
R2 mutating any target-week row cannot change any feature (tested)
R3 all-team skill history follows the athlete_id; current-team role history never crosses schools
R4 unresolved identities start as newcomers
R5 2026 Week >= 5 rejected by the research loader; the frozen research tables hold no 2026 row
